title: NIST WebBook: sodium chloride is ClNa, molecular weight 58.443 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists sodium chloride as ClNa, molecular weight 58.443 amu, CAS 7647-14-5.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for sodium chloride, CAS Registry Number 7647-14-5, lists molecular formula ClNa and molecular weight 58.443 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 57.95862196 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/ClH.Na/h1H;/q;+1/p-1. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
